e: Chinese national Lian Yong Wei dies in the custody of ICE in Saipan.
United States President Donald Trump declares a state of major disaster in the Northern Marianas Islands following Typhoon Sinlaku, allowing eligible residents to apply for disaster relief.
A cargo ship capsizes off the coast of the Northern Mariana Islands during Typhoon Sinlaku. Six crew members are lost; the bodt of one is recovered.
A typhoon watch is declared ahead of Typhoon Sinlaku, which makes landfall April 14.
